key_insight: TurtLES benchmarks neural PDE surrogates on realistic 3D turbulent wakes, exposing instability and loss of small-scale energy during autoregressive rollouts.
engineering_relevance: The benchmark tests whether learned CFD surrogates can handle long-horizon turbulent flows on irregular meshes at industrially relevant resolution.
method: Generate 3D cylinder wakes using high-fidelity implicit large-eddy simulations.
Vary geometry, Reynolds number, and angle of attack.
Evaluate neural operators through autoregressive temporal rollouts.
evidence_signal: The 14 TB dataset contains 400 trajectories with 400 time steps each and 3–11 million points per frame.
watch_item: Large irregular meshes pose substantial data-handling and learning challenges, while rollout stability remains a key concern.
paper_title: TurtLES: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Turbulent 3D Neural PDE Surrogates
